svg.title: One question, end to end, with a latency budget
svg.text: One question, end to end: what happens in the 1.5 seconds before the first word
p95 latency budget per step for the agent console (streamed). The customer portal adds a full-response grounding check before it shows the answer.
Time to first token, p95 budget (agent console)
Customer portal: answer is generated in full (about 300 tokens), checked by the grounding filter, then shown. Target p95 under 6 s with a typing indicator from step 1.
* Step 6 runs after the stream finishes on the agent console, so it adds to total time, not to time to first token. If grounding fails there, the answer is flagged in the UI.
All numbers are design budgets to measure against, not promises: your model, Region, prompt size and load change them.
